description:
The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} serves mocked usage and pricing. To "open the spend popup": navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, then click the VISIBLE ".context-usage-label" element (a hidden one may exist too; pick the visible one). "The popup" is the ".chat-context-popup" element; "the table" is the element inside the popup with role "table" and accessible name "Spend by model". When a step says an element's text "matches" a regular expression, test the regular expression against the element's raw textContent in an eval that has "expect". Perform the steps in order. The spend popup shows a zero total when sub-agent pricing is known and free.
1. Open the spend popup.
2. The popup's [data-testid="subagent-cost-row"] has exactly the text "$0".
3. The popup's [data-testid="token-cost-total"] has exactly the text "Total≈$0".
4. The popup's text does not contain "no pricing".
